scope: Read-only contingency for tracked_files subprocess consolidation. Browser candidate untouched; no patch staged/applied, tests/probes/benchmarks run, or runtime edits.

primary_sources.support: Typed peeling recursively resolves annotated tags until requested object type or fails; commit-only expression can be used as single object argument.
Accepts tree-ish argument; recursive name-only NUL output emits filenames without quoting, and cwd affects prefix unless full-tree is specified.
Current verification with commit peel enforces commit-ish objects; end-of-options avoids untrusted option interpretation.

bounded_conclusion: A built-in-only fast path can pass one validated revision^{commit} argument directly to existing ls-tree command, keeping commit-only selection and filename contract. Primary docs support concept, but installed-Git parity is still required before use.
requirements: Reject empty revision, leading hyphen and NUL exactly as current resolve_commit before any subprocess. Preserve one argv argument, no shell composition, and -r/--name-only/-z flags.

Retain original self.resolve_commit then ls-tree for every LocalGitService subclass and instance resolve_commit override, so existing policy denials/transforms remain authoritative. Exact built-in type and no instance override guard suggested.

Keep _execute inherited Git-environment sanitization, core.fsmonitor=false, hooksPath=os.devnull, credential-interaction settings, subprocess capture/error redaction and per-command timeout unchanged. No cache/caller status/graph or trusted SHA bypass.
Keep strict decode utf-8 and existing NUL splitting/empty filtering unchanged; do not silently replace undecodable filenames.
Keep cwd-relative behavior. Do not introduce --full-tree/--full-name as part of this optimization.
Do not stage/apply during current browser capture; if original browser qualification is clean, avoid an unnecessary new source candidate.
required_parity_cases: HEAD/fullSHA/unique abbreviated SHA/parent revisions/explicit refs/lightweight and annotated/nested commit tags
tree/blob/raw object and tags pointing to tree/blob rejected; missing/ambiguous/invalid refs fail
empty/leading hyphen/NUL denied without subprocess, whitespace special syntax not split
Unicode/tab/newline filenames preserve strict NUL contract; invalid UTF8 bytes still rejected where supported
nested cwd prefix and linked worktree inspection remain equivalent
two calls after HEAD/branch movement observe fresh committed files; dirty uncommitted files not included
subclass and instance resolve_commit policy denial and revision remapping retain legacy dispatch
same _execute environment/timeout/error redaction and one-call fast path vs two-call fallback
differences_and_limits: Missing/invalid object error text names ls-tree rather than rev-parse on fast path; GitError class and stderr redaction retained. Exact command/error strings are not equivalent.

Ref resolution happens inside listing instead of immediately before listing in a separate process. No cross-request/global atomicity promised; one listing still names one commit tree. A caller already supplying immutable status HEAD SHA remains immutable.
Per-command timeout remains identical; two old process time budgets become one new budget, no timeout increase.
Dynamic class-level monkeypatching and stateful custom executor command-count assumptions are outside exact built-in fast-path parity; actual private patch must be reviewed separately.
No current regression/5s cure, native browser pass, installed artifact, full qualification or release readiness claim.
